decisions.reason: It fits the reusable agriculture-packaging offer, but as a seasonal and narrower niche product it has a higher rationalization risk than the core transport lines.
A foldable large container is a core reusable-logistics product with clear cost and space-saving value for major industrial customers, so it is likely to stay.
A stackable plastic crate is a standard, versatile item that matches the firm's broad customer base and established manufacturing capabilities.
A medium-duty rackable pallet remains close to the firm's core pallet business, though overlap with other pallet options creates some portfolio-pruning risk.
The spill-retention pallet serves a useful compliance and safety niche, but it is somewhat less central to the main reusable transport-packaging portfolio.
The plastic pallet with load retainers supports transport stability and reuse goals, but as a more specialized variant it faces moderate consolidation risk if volumes are limited.
